nodes.description: owner: address of the contract owner declared in Owned.
newOwner: pending owner address awaiting acceptOwnership.
symbol: public token symbol string of NEXToken.
name: public token name string of NEXToken.
decimals: public uint8 token decimals.
_totalSupply: total token supply stored as uint.
balances: mapping(address => uint) holding token balances.
allowed: mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding allowances.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership() that finalises ownership transfer for newOwner.
safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure addition with require(c >= a).
safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure subtraction with require(b <= a).
safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure multiplication with overflow require.
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure division with require(b > 0).
NEXToken constructor that sets metadata and mints the total supply.
totalSupply() constant returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returning stored balance.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moving tokens from msg.sender.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writing the allowance mapping.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) using allowance of msg.sender.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant view of allowed mapping.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) that also calls the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that always reverts.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) restricted to onlyOwner.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authentication and balance keys.
Addition a + b inside safeAdd, only protected by require(c >= a).
Subtraction a - b inside safeSub, only protected by require(b <= a).
Multiplication a * b inside safeMul, checked with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division a / b inside safeDiv, checked with require(b > 0).
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with attacker-chosen spender.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary contract.
